cr_data.provenance: (The Downtown Gallery, New York, NY); Private collection, New York, NY, 1960; Private collection, Rutherford, New Jersey, gift, before 1992; Farleigh Dickinson College, Rutherford, New Jersey, before 1992; Sotheby's, New York, NY, sale no. 6374, lot no. 138, 3 December 1992 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Exam. at Amer. Place, April 1946 [note of inscription 1, but attributes to O'Keeffe]. . . . Label, An Amer. Place, 'Three Pears'/about 1927 [not verified]. Note: O'Keeffe told me ptd. 1924 when she looked at the photograph." Whitney Archive indicates "Three large yellow pears. Greyish–white background." Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date 1923. Possibly no. 48 in 1924 New York (Anderson) exhibition. Work of this subject mentioned in 1934 New York (An American Place) exhibition review in *New York Times* (1934). (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: Three yellow pears sit at the center of the canvas. The smooth fruits rest on a highly textured white and gray surface that resembles crinkled paper or fabric.
